dedupe_keys.name: donnees ouvertes sur les routes et panneaux signalisation au togo

description: Données Ouvertes sur les Routes et Panneaux Signalisation au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Les données sur les panneaux de signalisation le long des routes au Togo fournissent des informations essentielles sur les dispositifs destinés à guider, informer et assurer la sécurité des usagers de la route. Ces panneaux jouent un rôle clé dans la régulation de la circulation, la prévention des accidents, et la fluidité du trafic. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. Its tags are panneaux, panneaux-signalisation, routes, signalisation. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
